# What it is
The Block Workspace is where you build programs. It has three areas: the block palette on the left, the coding area in the middle and the run panel on the right.

# Using it
Drag blocks from the palette into the coding area and snap them together from top to bottom. Click the Run button to start and Stop to end. Drag a block back to the palette to delete it, or press Delete after clicking it.

# Handy features
Undo and redo are at the top. Right-click a block to duplicate it or add a comment. Use the zoom buttons to make blocks bigger or smaller, and the clean up button to tidy loose stacks. Your work saves automatically every few seconds.
